changes: Hold CUE and press LEFT or RIGHT to move the selected rows, or the cursor row, up or down one place.
LOOP and JUMP rows keep pointing at the rows they pointed at; moving back undoes a move.
While rows move, the editor scrolls along and keeps the row they move towards in view.
FUNC + DOWN on a HALT row keeps both rows HALTs, instead of stock's endless LOOP below it.
Hold CUE and press UP or DOWN in the arrangement editor to select rows.
FUNC + REC and FUNC + PLAY copy and clear the selected rows; FUNC + STOP replaces the selected rows, or the cursor row, with the copied rows; CUE + FUNC + STOP inserts them.
Paste copied rows into another arrangement after ARR CHANGE.
Without a selection, every key works as on stock.
